title: Fix Sketchpad Stale Framework Platform Package References
description: The sketchpad TS packages under compose/client/lib/sketchpad/ still reference the old, now-nonexistent npm package names @semio-tech/framework-platform-core and @semio-tech/framework-platform-renderer-react, left over from the framework/product/platform -> framework/product/os rename (npm packages renamed to @semio-tech/framework-os-core and @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react). Fix: rename all import references in compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts, boot.tsx, and compose/client/lib/sketchpad/doc/js/index.tsx to the new package names (verifying exported symbols still exist under new names, finding replacements if not), update package.json dependency declarations in js/package.json and doc/js/package.json to match sibling packages' convention, update tsconfig.json/vitest.config.ts path mappings, and verify with build/typecheck/test for both js/ and doc/js/ nx projects.
summary: Investigated the reported stale-package-name breakage in compose/client/lib/sketchpad. Confirmed 6 files reference dead packages @semio-tech/framework-platform-core / @semio-tech/framework-platform-renderer-react via node_modules symlinks (dated 2026-06-23) pointing at framework/product/platform/{core,renderer/react} — directories deleted by commit 5ecbe3dbfb (2026-07-04, "Rust kernel and WASM Component plugin OS replace TS meta-framework"), which removed ~110k lines of TS Platform/ActionBus/Controller/Store/Panel/PluginHost primitives repo-wide and replaced the product architecture with a Rust/WASM plugin host + declarative UiTree. Grepped the entire live tree and confirmed zero definitions remain anywhere for the ~50 symbols sketchpad imports under the old names — they were deleted, not renamed/moved, so this is not a simple package-rename fix. A prior ticket (26/07/16/FIX-DUPLICATE-TOP-LEVEL-DECLARATIONS-IN-SKETCHPAD-INDEX) already hit the same symlink and explicitly deferred it as out of scope. Renaming the import specifiers alone would resolve module lookup but leave ~50 undefined imports, still failing typecheck/build/runtime. A real fix requires either porting compose-sketchpad's 17.6k-line index.ts onto the new plugin/UiTree architecture (comparable in scope to the per-technology migrations in that commit) or a deliberate decision to rebuild those primitives as sketchpad-owned code — both are architecture decisions beyond a TS import-rename ticket, and the latter would conflict with CLAUDE.md's no-compat-layer rule if done as a shim. No source files were modified; full findings logged to investigation-findings.txt in this ticket folder. Recommending a properly scoped follow-up ticket, likely coordinated with the concurrent compose Rust-engine migration.
